findings.desc: Commit-hook failure is not fail-closed for validation reuse: done_prepare writes donePrepareValidationReuse before commitDonePrepareGeneratedMetadata attempts git commit, so a rejected auto-close commit leaves done-required-evidence.json claiming reused validation even though no auto-closeout commit exists and generated files remain staged. Reproduced in a temp TEST fixture with a failing pre-commit hook: transcript BLOCKED with git commit failed, last commit unchanged, hasReuseRecord=true, status shows staged done-required-evidence.json/test-evidence.json. Move reuse-record persistence after a successful safe commit or roll it back on commit failure.
